Governance Risk Compliance

Audit de conformité

A systematic, independent review to determine whether activities and related results comply with planned arrangements, policies, and regulatory requirements in information security and GRC frameworks.

Questions and answers

What is Audit de conformité?

In this glossary, Audit de conformité refers to: A systematic, independent review to determine whether activities and related results comply with planned arrangements, policies, and regulatory requirements in information security and GRC frameworks.

How is Audit de conformité used in cybersecurity?

In cybersecurity communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "L'audit de conformité a identifié plusieurs domaines où les contrôles internes ne répondaient pas entièrement aux normes réglementaires, nécessitant une action corrective rapide."

Why does Audit de conformité matter in cybersecurity?

Audit de conformité matters because it supports clear communication in Governance Risk Compliance contexts for SOC Analysts, Security Engineers, and Incident Responders. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as CISSP, CompTIA Security+, and CEH.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, MITRE ATT&CK and published by Protermify Cybersecurity as a static cybersecurity reference page.

Definition

A systematic, independent review to determine whether activities and related results comply with planned arrangements, policies, and regulatory requirements in information security and GRC frameworks.

Operational example

The compliance audit identified several areas where internal controls did not fully meet regulatory standards, requiring prompt corrective action.
